pick.name: FastEmbed (Qdrant, ONNX)
pick.what: CPU-only ONNX embeddings: dense, sparse (SPLADE), ColBERT and cross-encoder rerankers
pick.why: No GPU, no PyTorch, one lib covers embeddings + reranking; default bge-small-en-v1.5 (384-d)

alts.name: Gemini Embedding 2 (API)
alts.why: Highest convenience; free on free tier, $0.20/M text tokens paid ($0.10 batch)
alts.free_limits: Free tier free of charge (free tier data used to improve Google products)

alts.name: Transformers.js / sentence-transformers
alts.what: Run open embedding models (EmbeddingGemma 300M, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, bge, nomic) in Node/browser or Python
alts.why: TS-side embeddings with no Python service

candidates.name: Gemini Embedding 2 API
candidates.verdict: Alt: managed; paid tier ok for non-regulated data

candidates.name: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B
candidates.verdict: Apache, strong English MTEB per secondary guide, ~1.5GB

decision: Embed locally with FastEmbed so regulated data never leaves the box and cost stays $0; benchmark bge-small vs Qwen3-Embedding vs EmbeddingGemma on your own eval set before locking dimensions. Use Gemini Embedding 2 when multimodal or max quality matters and data is non-sensitive.
details: Whether FastEmbed supports Qwen3/EmbeddingGemma checkpoints is unverified.

verify.note: Shallow: pick reasonable for CPU embeddings.
